title: Production hardening: durable IDs and command idempotency
description: Harden Bridge for real project use. Inspect current db.ts and githubCommandBus.ts before editing. Requirements: (1) replace COUNT(*) task ID generation so deleting/rolling back rows cannot reuse an existing TASK id; use a collision-resistant monotonic-or-time/random strategy compatible with current TASK-* string IDs, and preserve existing tests where reasonable; (2) make GitHub command processing idempotent independently of bridge-bus/outbox files by persisting command IDs in the Bridge database, with a migration-safe CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and functions to query/record command receipts; (3) ensure a command receipt is recorded only after successful execution; failed commands remain retryable and errors must not mark them processed; (4) serialize task creation as needed to prevent same-process ID collisions; (5) add/update tests for duplicate command prevention and ID uniqueness; (6) run npm test, npm run lint, npm run build. Submit every changed text file through conflict-safe Studio Relay artifacts with correct base_sha. Do not modify protected runtime/secret paths, do not git push, do not approve.
